name: bromeme
description: 2.42.37: Van dashes at 750. The dash speed constant goes from 600 to 750 and, since the short and long multipliers are both 1.0 as of 2.42.36, that number is the speed he actually moves at (before 2.42.36 the 2.0 multiplier turned 600 into 1200). Durations unchanged, so the chain is still short, short, long. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.36: Van no longer doubles his dash speed. The short and long dash multipliers were both 2.0, so the 600 speed passed to the charge behaviour was really moving him at 1200; both multipliers are 1.0 now and the dash speed is the plain 600. The durations are untouched, so the three chain dashes are still short, short, long in length. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.35: Wang Yuan's second cigarette sits exactly 50 pixels from the first one. The previous pass pushed the extra cigarettes into a 90..200 pixel band around the boss, which read as too far apart, so the band constants are replaced by a single SMOKE_GAP of 50: the first cigarette stays on the boss itself and every extra one is offset by a random angle at exactly that distance. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.34: the challenger character is renamed to 牢师, so that is the name shown in character selection and in the codex. Only the display name changed - my_id stays character_bromeme_challenger_777, so existing saves keep working and every id based check (the forced meme invasion, the elite/boss kill bonus, the knockback aura) is untouched. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.33: (1) the test character 挑战者（无苍赫） is gone again - its json, its icon and the matching translation entry were removed, so the mod is back to the normal 21 characters. (2) Cang's pull and He's push no longer move bosses: the force step skips any unit whose enemy_data.is_boss is true (the same test the knockback aura uses), because shoving a boss around was distorting its own movement - most visible on Van, whose dash was being dragged off course. The contact damage of both orbs is unchanged and still hits bosses normally. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.32: dash speeds. Sun Xiaochuan dashes at two thirds of the previous speed (900 to 600; the value comes from his scene, so the script now sets charge_speed explicitly) and Van does too (DASH_SPEED 900 to 600, multiplied by the existing 2.0 hop multiplier as before). The traitor ninja dashes at three quarters of the previous speed (DASH_SPEED 937.5 to 703.125, that is 0.75 times, on top of the earlier 1250 to 937.5 reduction). Dash durations are unchanged, so each dash also covers proportionally less ground. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.31: Wang Yuan has 10 percent less health. Both the base value and the per-wave growth were scaled by 0.9 (health 150 to 135, health_increase_each_wave 675 to 607.5), so the reduction holds at every wave instead of only at wave 1. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.30: Wang Yuan's phase-2 cigarettes are placed further from his body. They used to land at a square random offset of up to 60 by 40 pixels around the boss, so the second cigarette often spawned almost on top of the first. Each extra cigarette now picks a random angle and a random radius in the SMOKE_MIN_DIST..SMOKE_MAX_DIST band (90..200 pixels), so they always keep a real minimum separation from the boss and from each other. The stagger interval is unchanged. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.29: (1) new test character 挑战者（无苍赫）(character_bromeme_challenger_test_888, resource 1790000999): exactly the challenger - same meme invasion every wave, +5 max HP, +20% damage, the elite/boss kill bonus and the knockback aura - but it carries NO starting orbs, so Cang and He are simply absent. Its menu icon is the challenger portrait with a red band and a yellow corner mark so the two are told apart at a glance. (2) Cang's damage is now half of He's, and this is done with VALUES rather than a code multiplier: the shared orb_weapon_stats.tres (damage 5) is He's, and a new orb_weapon_stats_cang.tres carries damage 2.5; the orb scenes and the two effect resources each point at their own file, and the CANG_DAMAGE_MULT multiplier was deleted from orb_pet.gd. Item descriptions read the same per-effect resource, so the number shown and the damage dealt can no longer drift apart. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.28: challenger overhaul. (1) New sprite for the challenger (art/char/1790000001.png, resized from the new art). (2) New items Cang and He: registered but not lootable (no_loot), so they never appear in the shop, and they are in the meme reward exclusive pool like the meme core. Both describe their damage as {0} ({1}) where the damage is 5 + 200 percent level + 50 percent meme value + 50 percent melee damage + 50 percent elemental damage. (3) The challenger starts with Cang and He (character json starting_items). (4) Cang and He orbit the challenger like the wandering robot but at a larger radius (240 vs its 100-200): Cang pulls enemies and bullets in, He pushes them away, and both continuously damage enemies they touch. (5) The challenger slows nearby enemies and enemy bullets: slowing starts at 150, grows with proximity, and reaches zero speed in contact. (6) Elite and boss kills now grant +5 HP regeneration and +5 percent damage instead of max HP and item price. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.27: fixed character body art vanishing after quitting and reloading, for real this time. An appearance only stores sprite.resource_path, and the mod builds its body texture by decoding png bytes at runtime, so the path is empty and the save recorded no sprite at all (inspected the save: the appearance entry is just depth, display_priority, is_character_appearance, position). Shipping .import/.stex is not an option either: mods are mounted from their zips as a virtual res:// with no writable directory on disk, so the earlier attempt to cache textures as .tres failed with err 19. Instead an extension on ItemAppearanceData adds bromeme_sprite_stem, which does get serialized, and the player_run_data extension decodes art/char/<stem>.png again after the run is loaded and assigns it back to the appearance. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.26: fixed character body art disappearing after quitting and reloading. An appearance stores sprite.resource_path (item_appearance_data.serialize), but the mod built its textures by decoding png bytes at runtime, and such an ImageTexture has an empty resource_path - so the save recorded no sprite and the character came back invisible. Vanilla pngs are not loadable either because mod art has no .import file (load() reports No loader found), and load() cannot take an absolute path. The fix caches each decoded texture into the game directory as a .tres (ImageTexture saves and loads fine as .tres and keeps a valid resource_path), so the appearance now references a loadable resource and survives a reload. If the cache cannot be written the mod falls back to a runtime texture and keeps working for the current session. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.25: the traitor ninja now decides to teleport from further away (TELEPORT_TRIGGER_DIST 150 to 250, so the check is distance to the player under 250 instead of under 150) on top of 2.42.24 which pushed the landing spot behind the player out to 360. Combined with the 120 minimum landing distance, a teleport that fires always lands 360 away from the player. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.24: fixed a native crash (Brotato.exe access violation 0xc0000005) caused by card items. The card item script from 2.42.22 called set_script() on an already instantiated Resource (the item is duplicated from a shared template), which rebuilds the script instance and can leave dangling references; the crash happened when the pick panel handed over a meme core card and the next shop transition ran the icon repair over ItemService.items, with no SCRIPT ERROR in the log because the fault is in the engine, not in GDScript. The script attachment is gone: card items are plain ItemData/UpgradeData again, and the icon source is persisted in a small side file (user://bromeme_card_icons.json, card item id to source card id) written when the card is handed out, so the icon is rebuilt from that record first, then from the id itself, then from the resources index. Balance: the Sun Xiaochuan letter volley fans out wider (LETTER_FLIGHT_FAN 0.12 to 0.22) and the traitor ninja teleports further (TELEPORT_BACK_DIST 260 to 360, +100). some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.23: fixed the main script extension failing to parse, which silently disabled everything it hooks. A function signature and its first body line had been merged onto one line (func _bromeme_is_character(...) -> bool:    var players = ...), so the file raised "Unexpected indentation" at line 408 and ModLoader installed the extension against Null instead of res://main.gd - visible only as "Installing script extension: Null <- .../brolab_compat/extensions/main.gd" in modloader.log. While that was broken the player-spawned hook never ran, so the challenger no longer forced a meme invasion every wave, and the card icon repair never ran either. The line is split again and the extension installs against res://main.gd. Standalone parse checks now cover the three extensions that are easy to break this way (main.gd, player_run_data.gd and the new card_item.gd), because a parse failure there is silent: the game still runs with the whole extension gone. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.22: card items keep their icon reliably now, using the same trick as the Capybara mod (Dbear-Capybara). The icon of a card item is composed at runtime (source picture plus the mod logo watermark) and vanilla serialize never stores a Texture, so after a reload the item came back with no picture. Rebuilding it on load also cannot be trusted: a real save-load happens BEFORE mod content is installed (measured: ItemService.items held only the 377 vanilla items at that moment, our 95 were not registered yet), so looking the source up by id fails and a late retry updates the item after the inventory already rendered an empty slot. Capybara solves this by putting the icon resource path INTO the save and loading it back, so card items now use a small script of their own that does exactly that: serialize writes bromeme_icon_path, deserialize_and_merge loads it back (mod pngs are decoded from bytes because they have no import cache, anything else goes through load). A fallback that resolves the source from the resources index remains for cards that have no stored path. Also fixed in this pass: the memeboss balance tweaks from 2.42.20 (Van waits 1s longer after his three-dash chain, the traitor ninja dashes 25 percent slower). some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.21: card items keep their icon after a save reload. 2.42.19 restored the card items themselves but they came back without a picture, because a Texture cannot be serialized into the save and the rebuilt item had a null icon. The card id encodes its source (item_bromeme_pick_<kind>_<tag>, where tag is the source item id for swap/exclusive/mix/character cards and stat_a>stat_b for job cards), so on load the mod now derives the source again and re-runs the same watermark step that created the icon in the first place. Note the id contains its prefix twice (the card is bromeme_pick|job|tag, and turning it into an item prepends item_bromeme_pick_ and replaces the pipes with underscores), so both are stripped. If a source cannot be resolved the mod logs one line naming the item instead of staying silent. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.20: three balance changes. (1) The job-change card no longer hands out the extra random buff it used to append after the convert - it now only removes the source stat and adds the converted target stat. (2) Van waits 1 second longer after his three-dash chain (COOLDOWN 2.0 to 3.0), so his dash cycle is 2 short plus 1 long dash, then 3 seconds of cooldown. (3) The traitor ninja (panren) dashes 25 percent slower (DASH_SPEED 1250 to 937.5); his dash distance is speed times time, so each dash covers 25 percent less ground. both enemy scripts were parse-checked with a standalone harness. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.19: fixed the meme reward items (the cards turned into items by the 4-pick panel: fusion, modified, job-change and the meme items) disappearing after a save reload or a game restart. Root cause: card items are generated at runtime and were only appended to ItemService.items in memory. Vanilla rebuilds each saved player item by looking its saved my_id up in ItemService.items and SILENTLY DROPS anything it cannot find (player_run_data.gd:177), so once the process ended that runtime entry was gone and every card item was lost on the next load. A save file comparison proves the item was written correctly (backups at 00:08:01 and 00:08:38 contain it, the save written after the reload at 00:09:22 does not), so only the load side was broken. Fix: a new script extension on progress_data_loader_v3.gd runs before deserialization, reads the card items out of the save, rebuilds each one as an UpgradeData and registers it into ItemService.items (merging the saved name and effects back in), so the vanilla lookup by my_id succeeds again. The temporary diagnostics are removed. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.18: fixed the job-change (and swap) cards showing other mods stats wrong, and simplified the job card explain line. Two symptoms, one cause - other mods stat translations differ from vanilla ones. (1) The name and the explain line showed a double percent sign, e.g. 转职：%%暴击率 -> 时光: the card built those strings from tr(stat_key) and that mods translation already contains a % sign, while vanilla Text.text adds another one on the effect rows. Stat labels used in card names and in the explain line now go through bromeme_stat_label, which strips the percent sign so it is added exactly once (on the effect rows). (2) The effect rows lost their number, e.g. -3 %%暴击率 and +2 %%生命窃取 instead of a value plus name: those mods stats are neither in keys_needing_operator nor do their translations carry a {0} placeholder. All stat effect rows built by the job card, the swap card and the extra random buff now go through _bromeme_fix_stat_effect_text, which only rewrites a row when it would otherwise render without a number, so vanilla stat rows are untouched. (3) The job card explain line now only shows this rolls own ratio, e.g. 转职：全部 暴击率 -> 时光（本次 1:1.85）, without the base value ratio and the -50 to +100 percent range. The temporary stat-table diagnostics are removed again. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.18: fixed the job-change (and swap) cards showing other mods stats wrong. The temporary stat-table diagnostics are removed again. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.17: cleanup release. The temporary diagnostics added while chasing the challenger invasion report are removed (the player-spawn invasion probe, the primary-stat name probe and the stat effect text probe), so the boot log is back to just the unlock diagnostics. No gameplay change: this build is 2.42.16 plus the meme core effect text fix (it now reads meme value +3 in zh/en/ja/ko/ru, the actual gain was already +3). The challenger report turned out to be the endless-wave bug fixed in 2.42.16. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.16: five changes. (1) Fixed meme invasions never happening past wave 20: the check bailed out with wave > nb_of_waves, which is the vanilla guard meant for consumable drops in endless mode - meme invasions are a mod mechanic and now keep rolling in endless waves. (2) Fixed the meme reward items (fusion / modified / job-change cards turned into items, and the meme items) disappearing after a save reload: vanilla rebuilds player items by looking the saved my_id up in ItemService.items and silently DROPS anything it cannot find (player_run_data.gd:177), and the card items were runtime-only with a generated id. Card items now get a stable unique id (repeats of the same card get _2 / _3 suffixes) and are registered into ItemService.items with unlocked_by_default false and can_be_looted false, so they are findable on load and still never appear in the shop or in item boxes. (3) Meme core now grants +3 meme value per shop purchase instead of +1. (4) The invasion chance curve is now y = 1 - exp(-(max(x,0)/100)^0.9) (1 point 1.6 percent, 9 points 10.8 percent, 100 points 63.2 percent) in both the roll and the stat info line. (5) The pick panel reroll costs another half of what it was (REROLL_PRICE_FACTOR 0.5 to 0.25), so wave 1 costs 4 and wave 10 costs 52. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.15: four things. (1) Gambler meme now says materials instead of gold in all five languages - the games currency variable is player_data.gold but the Chinese UI calls it 材料 (the hoarder achievement reads get_player_gold), so this is wording only. (2) Gambler meme also grants +30 meme value. (3) The gambler is not broken, but doubling or wiping 0 materials does nothing, so it now writes an explicit log line instead of returning silently, and every branch logs the before/after amounts - if you still see it do nothing while you have materials, send me that log line. (4) The 8 meme panel items (meme core, chaos, random, sell, entropy, gambler, quantum, sacrifice) are locked now: the json carries locked true, which sets unlocked_by_default false (codex shows them locked) and can_be_looted false (so they cannot appear in the shop pool, and item boxes use that same pool), while the card panel still hands them out normally. A guard was added to the shop-transition re-unlock helper so it can never push these back into the unlocked table. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.14: the meme pick panel reroll costs half as much (REROLL_PRICE_FACTOR = 0.5, applied to the final price so every wave and every reroll inside the panel is exactly halved). The formula is still (5 + 10*wave) * (1 + wave*0.1) with the x1.25 escalation per reroll, so wave 1 now costs 8, wave 5 costs 41 and wave 10 costs 105 for the first reroll. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.13: sell meme also gives +5 to every primary stat (on top of the 100% gold recycle, +25 harvesting and +35 meme value). It walks Utils.get_primary_stat_keys() - the same range the entropy and sacrifice memes use - and skips the kill-counter stats through the shared bromeme_stat_skipped helper, so no counter is touched. Because stat_meme is itself flagged as a primary stat, that +5 lands on meme value as well, so sell meme ends up granting +40 meme value in total; say the word if you want memes excluded from this +5. The effect text was updated in zh/en/ja/ko/ru. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.12: two changes. (1) Random meme and meme core now also grant +30 meme value - a second effect entry built the same way the other +meme value items use (cake_effect_1 with key stat_meme and value 30). (2) hun5 no longer stands still while using its melee attacks: the 0.3s wind-up and the swing now move at 60% speed instead (MELEE_MOVE_SPEED_FACTOR = 0.6), which is done by temporarily lowering bonus_speed (unit.gd adds it into get_move_speed) and is restored when the attack ends, when it is interrupted, and every frame in the idle state as a safety net, so the speed can never stay reduced. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.11: three fixes. (1) Quantum meme no longer swaps characters: vanilla keeps characters inside the item list, so the same-tier swap could turn one of your characters into an item - character_ entries are now skipped by the swap and by the 1-8 extra items. (2) Sell meme no longer eats worthless items and can never touch a character: it keeps every item whose value is 0 or less (selling those paid nothing, you just lost them) and the log now says how many were kept. (3) Fixed hun5 freezing in place after a melee attack: the cleanup that frees the leftover weapon sprite only restored _can_move, not _move_locked, so an interrupted weapon swing (or blade thrust) left _move_locked = true forever and unit.gd then returned a zero movement vector - the boss simply stopped moving. Both flags are restored now, the wind-up timer is cleared on interrupt, and the idle state resets both flags every frame as a safety net. Also the hun5 melee wind-up is 0.3s instead of 0.5s (MELEE_WINDUP_TIME). some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.10: the hun5 melee attacks (the sickle thrust, the sickle swing and the sword swing/slash) now stand still while attacking and got a 0.5s wind-up (MELEE_WINDUP_TIME). Before this the weapon swings chased the player while swinging, and there was no wind-up at all. Now every one of those three attacks locks the boss in place for the whole action (movement is held down with _can_move=false + _move_locked=true + _current_movement=0, so the charge/keep-away behaviours cannot move it either) and plays a 0.5s wind-up first: the sickle stops at its start angle and the spell blade stays home, and the 180-degree spike fan of the sword attack is now released when the wind-up ends instead of at the same instant the attack starts. The blade hitbox is pulled back home during the wind-up too, so the wind-up itself cannot hurt you, and the sword sprite fades correctly again after a re-swing. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.9: the missing-nin (panren) phase-2 dash chain got a wind-up and a range gate. It now stands still and flashes for 0.5s (the same wind-up the spike-then-dash action already used) before the chain, and the whole chain only fires when the boss is further than DASH_CHAIN_MIN_DIST = 300 from the target - if the player is closer the action is dropped and the boss just finishes it with the normal cooldown instead of dashing. The distance is checked twice: when the action is picked and again when the wind-up ends, so a player who steps inside 300 during the wind-up is not charged. The wind-up now carries what it should do afterwards (dash count / finish with shurikens / minimum distance), so the spike action keeps its old single-dash wind-up while the phase-2 action reuses the same code. The chain is still two dashes (DASH_CHAIN_COUNT = 2) - tell me if you want three. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.8: two meme items reworked. Quantum meme now turns every item in your inventory into another item of the same tier (it used to change one random item into a random item of any tier), then additionally grants 1 to 8 extra items and +25 meme value; the replacement pool is the shop pool, and an item whose tier has no other entry in the pool is left untouched instead of vanishing. Sell meme keeps recycling everything at 100% of its price and now also grants +25 harvesting and +35 meme value. Both effect texts were updated in zh/en/ja/ko/ru, and the shop pool used by these effects is now cached (the quantum meme matches every owned item against its tier, which would otherwise rescan the whole pool per item). Tier pools measured in game: tier0 113, tier1 135, tier2 144, tier3 93 items. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.7: the fusion card and the stat-swap cards (the plain swap card and the swap+fuse combo card) now hard-refuse any item that is not sold in the shop. They already only drew from the shop pool, so nothing changes in normal play - this is an explicit guard (bromeme_is_pickable -> item.can_be_looted) on top of the pool filter, so those three cards can never use one of the mods 24 non-shop items (4-choice exclusives, meme event items, the research line, character starting kit items) as material even if the pool logic changes later. The card builder also handles the refused case cleanly now: a refused card is skipped instead of being added as an empty card, pair cards cannot overflow the cursor, and two card types that could stop early without refilling the slot now fall through to the next card type. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.6: two fixes for the expanded card pool. (1) Fusion card names are readable again: vanilla and other mods items store a translation key in their name field (ITEM_ACID, ITEM_SPINE_SWORD_IV, ...), and the half-and-half naming was slicing that key, so the card showed things like ITEM_SPINEEDGEHOG. Names are now resolved first (same as vanilla get_name_text -> tr(name), and through it for our own items too). (2) The random draw card (the one that puts 3-4 effects on a card) and the job-change cards random buff used to read every item in the game, including this mods 24 non-shop items and other mods hidden content, so non-sellable items kept appearing. Both now take their effects from the shop pool only (the same ItemService._tiers_data ITEMS pool the shop and the fusion pool use). Measured: 485 shop items, 0 of them with can_be_looted false. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.5: the fusion / modified card pool now covers every item that can be sold in the shop - vanilla items and other mods items included - instead of only this mods 71 shop items. The pool is read straight from ItemService._tiers_data (the pool vanilla init_unlocked_pool builds), so it uses exactly the same rules as the shop: can_be_looted, unlocked, max_nb != 0, and it never contains weapons, consumables or characters. Measured in game: 485 items total, 71 of them from this mod. The 24 non-shop items of this mod (4-choice exclusives, meme event items, the research line, character starting kit items) stay out of the pool. Note that fusing or modifying an item that can be taken more than once means the card can no longer be taken again once you hold max_nb of it. A 组合池 log line reports the pool size whenever the panel opens. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.4: the wave-end card pool is limited to shop items again. The mod has 95 items but only 71 of them are meant to show up in the shop (the other 24 are the 4-choice exclusives, the meme event items, the research line and the character starting kit ones). The pool used to be filtered by ProgressData.items_unlocked, which only happened to equal the 24 shop items before 2.42.2 and now equals all 95, so the fusion and modified cards had started combining the exclusive items too. The filter is now item.can_be_looted (the same condition the shop pool uses), so the pool is the intended 71 items again; a 组合池 log line reports the pool size whenever the panel opens. The codex still shows all 95 as unlocked. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.3: the mod no longer touches user://brolab. The startup cleanup that removed the 0.1.x json files this mod had copied into the BroLab folder is now disabled (BROLAB_CLEANUP_ENABLED = false), so the BroLab content library (hundreds of json files plus their icons) is left completely alone. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.2: all mod items now show as unlocked in the codex. The json field unlocked_by_default no longer decides item.unlocked_by_default (that is always true now), so the 71 items that are meant to be obtained from the wave-end 4-choice panel, meme events or a character starting kit are no longer greyed out next to the 24 shop items. Nothing else was changed on purpose: can_be_looted and the shop pool work exactly as before, because the shop was not part of this request. Log check: 解锁诊断：本 mod 道具 95 件（其中 unlocked_by_default 95 件），… 未在解锁表里的 0 件. some characters and items created by Brolab. 2.42.2: two follow-ups after 2.42.1. (1) every item now shows as unlocked in the codex: the json field unlocked_by_default no longer decides item.unlocked_by_default (that is always true now) and instead only decides can_be_looted, so the 71 event / 4-choice-only items are unlocked in the codex but still do not enter the shop pool. (2) the shop actually shows the mod items: 24 shop items against 100-157 items per tier meant a real chance of only 0.4 percent per shop at wave 2, 3.9 percent at wave 5 and 36.6 percent cumulative by wave 10 (wave 1 is always tier COMMON and the mod has no COMMON item), which is why the shop still looked empty in practice. The mod now extends ItemService._get_rand_item_for_wave: the vanilla roll is kept for every rule (weapon guarantee, duplicates, tags, bans) and the slot is then replaced by one of the mod items of that tier with probability BROMEME_SHOP_SLOT_CHANCE (currently 1.0, so at least one mod item per shop; lower it to make them rarer).
